elder_toadstool.name: Clan Keep
elder_toadstool.description: The hidden heart of your clan. Upgrade it to unlock new buildings, warriors and higher levels.

acorn_orchard.name: Coin Mint
acorn_orchard.description: Artisans stamp fresh Coins every hour. Holds 8 hours of output, so collect often.

dewdrop_well.name: Terraced Farm
dewdrop_well.description: Terraced fields that grow Provisions for your warriors. Holds 8 hours of output.

acorn_silo.name: Treasury
acorn_silo.description: A locked vault for your Coins. Bigger treasuries let you save for bigger upgrades.

dew_cistern.name: Provision Storehouse
dew_cistern.description: Stores Provisions for your warriors. Raiders can only carry off part of what is inside.

beaver_lodge.name: Artisan's Hut
beaver_lodge.description: Home of a Village Artisan. Each hut lets you build or upgrade one thing at a time.

burrow_barracks.name: Training Dojo
burrow_barracks.description: Trains warriors and studies battle scrolls to make them stronger. Higher levels unlock new warriors.

army_camp.name: Squad Courtyard
army_camp.description: Where trained warriors wait for the next raid. Each level houses more.

acorn_cannon.name: Kunai Tower
acorn_cannon.description: A lookout that throws volleys of kunai at warriors on the ground. Cannot hit flyers.

pinecone_catapult.name: Firework Mortar
pinecone_catapult.description: Launches bursting fireworks that splash groups of warriors on the ground. Slow, and blind to warriors right beside it.

wasp_nest.name: Shuriken Tower
wasp_nest.description: Spinning shuriken strike warriors on the ground and in the air.

firefly_tower.name: Sky Bow Tower
firefly_tower.description: Archers with great bows that hit flying warriors hard. Ignores warriors on the ground.

bramble_hedge.name: Stone Wall
bramble_hedge.description: Fitted mountain stone. Warriors walk around it or break through it. Higher levels add iron-banded gates. Builds instantly.

thorn_snare.name: Spike Pit
thorn_snare.description: A hidden pit of bamboo spikes that springs when warriors on the ground step close. Unseen until it goes off.

sap_puddle.name: Caltrop Field
sap_puddle.description: Hidden iron caltrops that slow warriors on the ground to half speed for a few seconds.

flower_bed.name: Bonsai Planter
flower_bed.description: A carefully shaped little pine. Purely decorative.

lantern_post.name: Stone Lantern
lantern_post.description: A carved stone lantern that glows through the night. Purely decorative.

mushroom_ring.name: Rock Garden
mushroom_ring.description: Raked gravel and three quiet stones. Purely decorative.

mossy_statue.name: Stone Sentinel Statue
mossy_statue.description: A weathered stone sentinel that watches the gate. Purely decorative.

obstacle_bush.name: Bamboo Thicket
obstacle_bush.description: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!

obstacle_stump.name: Fallen Cedar
obstacle_stump.description: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!

obstacle_rock.name: Mountain Boulder
obstacle_rock.description: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!

grove_lodge.name: Alliance Lodge
grove_lodge.description: Your link to your Alliance. Holds the warriors your allies send you, ready for your next raid.

paper_lantern_line.name: Paper Lantern Line
paper_lantern_line.description: Lanterns strung low between posts. Hidden or mist-veiled ground warriors within 2 tiles are lit up for a few seconds: defenses can see them, and lit warriors take extra damage. Once it has lit someone, the line itself is no longer hidden.

clockwork_repairer.name: Clockwork Repair Crane
clockwork_repairer.description: A mechanic's crane that reaches over nearby defenses: jams, stuns and a Hawk Tamer's slowing on defenses within 3 tiles are cut short. A few repairs per battle.

bitter_incense_burner.name: Bitter Smoke Brazier
bitter_incense_burner.description: Burns bitter herbs: warriors within 3 tiles receive less healing, and healing, haste and toughness auras and shelter shields work at reduced strength on them.

kite_cutter_ballista.name: Kite-Cutter Ballista
kite_cutter_ballista.description: Air only. Fires a spinning bolas that tangles anything with wings or strings: a flyer it hits is grounded for 3 seconds, where ground defenses can reach it. A flyer that breaks free can't be tangled again for 3 seconds.

longbow_yagura.name: Longbow Yagura
longbow_yagura.description: A tall archery tower with range 13 that outranges every siege warrior. It prefers warriors attacking from 3.5 tiles or more (throwers and artillery), but cannot hit anything closer than 2 tiles.
